meta.title: Email Notifications: on failure — failed emails retried 3x
gaps: Configure the outbound Email Notifications integration with its provider and authentication settings
Make the external email provider fail or become unreachable
Trigger an approval request, bid invitation, PO issuance, or another email workflow event
Observe evidence that the failed email was retried exactly three times and was not silently dropped
